display.name: Eve
display.description: Turns, conversations, LLM calls, token usage, latency, tools, subagents and failures for agents built on eve, Vercel's agent framework, from its OpenTelemetry traces. Token panels read chat spans only, and failure panels use agent.turn.outcome so cancelled turns are not counted as errors.

display.name: Service
display.description: Service running eve.

display.name: Environment
display.description: Deployment environment.

display.name: Turns
display.description: Agent turns (invoke_agent spans), including subagent turns. Each turn is its own trace.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent'

display.name: Conversations
display.description: Distinct sessions (gen_ai.conversation.id). A subagent shares its parent's session, and /new keeps the same id.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent'

display.name: LLM Calls
display.description: Model calls across all agents (chat spans).

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'chat'

display.name: Input Tokens
display.description: Prompt tokens, summed over chat spans only. invoke_agent and agent.step spans repeat the same totals, so summing every span triples the figure. Includes cache reads.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'chat'

display.name: Output Tokens
display.description: Completion tokens, summed over chat spans only.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'chat'

display.name: Turn Failure Rate
display.description: Share of turns with agent.turn.outcome = failed. Cancelled turns and recovered tool failures are excluded, unlike a has_error count.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent' AND agent.turn.outcome = 'failed'
service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent'

display.name: Token Usage Over Time
display.description: Input, output, and cache-read tokens from chat spans. Cache reads are a subset of input; on long sessions they are most of it.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'chat'
service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'chat'
service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'chat'

display.name: LLM Calls by Model
display.description: Chat call volume per served model.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'chat' AND gen_ai.response.model EXISTS

display.name: Tokens by Model
display.description: Calls and tokens per served model and provider. gen_ai.provider.name reads openai.responses for eve's openai() helper and gateway for AI Gateway model strings.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'chat' AND gen_ai.response.model EXISTS

display.name: Tokens by Agent
display.description: Turns and tokens per agent, from invoke_agent spans. Subagent usage is reported on the subagent's own turn, not rolled into its caller.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent' AND gen_ai.agent.name EXISTS

display.name: LLM Call Latency
display.description: p50 / p95 / p99 duration of chat spans.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'chat'

display.name: Turn Latency (p95)
display.description: p95 end-to-end turn duration per agent, including every model step, tool call, and subagent dispatch in the turn.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent' AND gen_ai.agent.name EXISTS

display.name: Model Steps per Turn
display.description: Average agent.step spans per turn. Each tool round trip adds a step, so a rising line means agents need more tool calls to answer.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND name = 'agent.step'
service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent'

display.name: Finish Reasons
display.description: Why each model call ended. tool-calls and stop dominate a healthy tool-using agent; a growing length slice means responses are being cut off.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'chat' AND gen_ai.response.finish_reasons EXISTS

display.name: Agents
display.description: Turns, failed and cancelled turns, and average turn latency per agent, from agent.turn.outcome.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent' AND gen_ai.agent.name EXISTS

display.name: Tools
display.description: Calls, failures, and average latency per authored tool (execute_tool spans). A tool failure does not fail the turn, so this is where it shows up.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'execute_tool' AND gen_ai.tool.name EXISTS

display.name: Tool Calls Over Time
display.description: Authored tool invocations per tool.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'execute_tool' AND gen_ai.tool.name EXISTS

display.name: Actions by Kind
display.description: Every action the model took (agent.action spans): authored tools, provider-executed tools such as web_search that have no execute_tool span, and subagent calls.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND name = 'agent.action' AND agent.action.name EXISTS

display.name: Turn Outcomes
display.description: Turns over time by agent.turn.outcome: completed, failed, cancelled.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent' AND agent.turn.outcome EXISTS

display.name: Tool Error Rate
display.description: Share of authored tool executions that threw.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'execute_tool' AND has_error = true
service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'execute_tool'

display.name: LLM Error Rate
display.description: Share of model calls that failed, excluding cancellations, which eve marks as TurnCancelledError on the chat span.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'chat' AND has_error = true AND error.type != 'TurnCancelledError'
service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'chat'

display.name: Errors by Type
display.description: Errored agent spans by error.type and span. A model failure appears on chat, agent.step, and invoke_agent; a cancellation appears as TurnCancelledError below the turn.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND has_error = true AND error.type EXISTS

display.name: Recent Errors
display.description: Latest errored agent spans with their error class and message.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND has_error = true AND error.type != 'TurnCancelledError'
